updates.message: There's just a lot of printers and monitors at the moment, and some PC shells. Check it out if you want some random electronic bits.
Around 10/28, there was a dump of video film and film reels! That's pretty much still there, be sure to have a look if you're interested! Almost zero change since then, though.
The 3 boxes are slowly but surely being picked apart more and more, still a ton of empty PC cases and assorted parts of electronic things.

This one's been really active lately. There's been a thinkpad thrown out, plus a Sun Microsystems mainfrome or server PC or something like that, the parts are still there. Plus, tons of landline phone supplies, including a landline, if anyone wants to try using it around campus.
The MRC has had a lot lately, from laptops to PCs to microwaves to projectors. The boxes are still pretty full if you haven't seen them yet!
Cogswell still quite empty. Literally like 3 things in there, 2 out of those 3 are scraps.
In Sage, there's some power drill things and some wires. Not nearly as much as a week or so ago, but still something.
In West, printers, string lights, a DVD player (find of the week last semester?). There's an AC unit, some trashed laptops, and a smashed flatscreen TV. Lots of wires, too.
Cassette Radio and CD player were found recently, both presumably working. Though they have been already taken. a small Sony flatscreen remains.
